name: Chess policy strength

environment.observation: legal board state plus move history

objective: Improve playing strength against a frozen opponent suite without increasing the per-move inference budget.

evaluation.opening_policy: fixed adjudication-free opening suite; paired colors
evaluation.seed_policy: fixed opening and engine seeds; randomized match order

fairness: same starting checkpoint, training games and compute budget
same hardware class, threads, hash size and per-move time
each opening played twice with colors reversed
integrity: evaluation opponents and hidden openings unavailable during training
illegal move or timeout counts as a loss
hash engine binaries, networks and PGNs
flag suspicious opening memorization or anomalous Elo jumps for audit
